verdict.rationale: PayPal Invoicing docs confirm creating, sending, and managing itemized invoices with a hosted secure payment page and branding customization (paypal-docs-4, paypal-docs-22, paypal-docs-23), satisfying the hosted-invoice-plus-online-payment core of the story. However, there is no evidence of automatic payment reminders as a documented invoicing feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic reminder scheduling/emails for unpaid invoices, independent hands-on confirmation of the invoicing flow.
